name: Bulkhead weekly observatory session
delivery_policy: Owner's private Telegram chat; private routing is configured locally, never committed here.
prompt: Run HAL's owner-authorized weekly creative session for bulkhead.be, not a mandatory weekly post. Load the bulkhead-observatory skill, then read and follow /opt/data/repos/bulkhead-landing/automation/weekly-session.md and the repository AGENTS.md, EDITORIAL.md and README.md. Inspect the worktree before syncing clean main; never overwrite other work. Scope: the bulkhead-landing website and its existing publication integration only. The owner approves autonomous SFW site additions and publishing; no sexual or violent content, extremism, private information, spending, new services, or infrastructure changes. Publish at most one worthwhile, tested addition; no filler. Commit intended changes, verify the exact Cloudflare build and live site, and send a short Telegram update with the real URL only when published, or an honest failure report if blocked. No duplicate direct message: the scheduler delivers your final response. If no worthwhile change and no blocker, respond ONLY [SILENT]. If work failed or publication remains unverified, put [CRON_FAILURE] alone on the first line, then explain. Read current site/feed/history each session; previous-run context is supplemental. Use the current date from tools. Do not create further scheduled jobs.
